name: Arena
desc: Blind A/B comparison of AI models with a public leaderboard.
desc_zh: AI 模型盲测 A/B 对比，配套公开排行榜。
solves: Ranks models by what real users prefer in blind tests, instead of by vendor benchmark claims.
solves_zh: 按真实用户盲测偏好排名模型，而不是按厂商自报的跑分。
best_for: Reaching for it when you want to pick a model by evidence rather than by marketing.
best_for_zh: 想凭证据而不是宣传来选模型时。
notes: 外部发现渠道补录：Similarweb global AI traffic list, #31 with ~22.2M monthly visits (LMArena)。来源：https://arena.ai/blog/lmarena-is-now-arena
